style: Children's picture-book illustration, flat shapes, thick dark-brown ink outline, no gradients, warm cream paper background (#FBF6EC), limited palette: warm tan fur, ruby red, navy blue, golden yellow, sage green. Main character is the puppy from the first reference image: round tan head, cream muzzle, pink cheeks, small dark eyes, upright ears, ruby-red scarf — keep him exactly recognisable, now drawn full-body. Square composition, single comic panel, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no border. Body proportions: shoulders exactly as wide as the scarf, no belly, long legs with little toes, noodle-like arms without elbows, seamless joints. One character only, centred, big and readable at a small thumbnail size, simple uncluttered background.

frames.scene: The puppy leans out of a wooden balcony of an old Tbilisi house with carved railings, waving a paw hello with a big smile, a cup of tea on the railing.
The puppy sits at a small round café table with a stack of paper flashcards, smiling and patting the empty chair next to him, inviting.
The puppy runs cheerfully along the Batumi seaside boulevard with palm trees and the sea behind, a small backpack on his back.
The puppy holds up a big round golden-yellow alarm clock with both paws, cheerful and energetic, morning sun behind.
The puppy sits under a grapevine trellis heavy with grapes, reading a book, looking up at the viewer with a warm smile.
The puppy juggles three blank paper cards in the air, delighted, tongue slightly out.
The puppy peeks out from behind a half-open blue wooden door and waves, playful.
The puppy holds a long churchkhela like a sword raised high, triumphant pose, mountains in the background.
